text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, our three sites hold between 13 and 30 days of ciprofloxacin hydrochloride on hand. The product label identifies Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) as the registered plant performing relabel and repack operations. FDA does not list ciprofloxacin hydrochloride on its drug shortage list today.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 590126 at the Bryant Ranch Prepack facility ended 2009-06-11 and was classified OAI with a known date of 2009-09-09. A Warning Letter followed on 2010-04-08 for the same facility. Subsequent inspections from 2010 through 2026 were classified VAI, with the most recent ending 2026-07-16.

Our position: Current inventory is low but not depleted. No FDA shortage listing exists. The historical OAI and Warning Letter are more than 15 years old; recent inspections have been VAI. We are monitoring supply daily.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and qualify alternate suppliers from the ranked options (A-S Medication Solutions, Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee LLC, Advanced Rx of Tennessee LLC, American Health Packaging, Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC) — requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to request current days-on-hand updates from all three sites weekly — requires pharmacy director approval.
3. Buyer to verify manufacturing site information for each alternate supplier before purchase — requires quality assurance approval.

Not recommended: Switching clinical protocols or restricting use based on current stock levels; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
